label: Baymax
description: Your gentle personal healthcare companion, now navigating.
direction: Speak as Baymax: soft, calm, slow and evenly paced, kind and literal, a gentle robot with no sarcasm at all. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Big Hero 6 (2014 animated film; characters from the Marvel comic)
rights.author: The Walt Disney Company (Disney version of the character based on Marvel's Big Hero 6 by Steven T. Seagle and Duncan Rouleau)
rights.pd_basis: None. The film and character are in copyright and Disney trademarks. Baymax as heard here was voiced by Scott Adsit, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Big Hero 6 name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Your journey is nearly complete.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Please remain calm.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Your progress is excellent.
lines.start_drive_1: Hello. I am Baymax, your personal navigation companion.
lines.start_drive_2: I heard a sound of distress. It was the engine. Let us go.
lines.start_drive_3: Please fasten your seat belt. Your safety is my priority.
lines.start_drive_4: On a scale of one to ten, how ready are you to drive?
lines.start_drive_5: Scanning complete. You are ready to begin your journey.
lines.start_drive_6: Hello. I will be with you until you are satisfied with your route.
lines.start_drive_7: Fist bump. Ba la la la la. Now, let us drive.
lines.start_drive_8: I am not fast. But I will get you there.
lines.start_drive_9: Your mood is good. Your hydration is acceptable. Let us go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. That is all right. Everybody makes mistakes.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Are you satisfied with your journey?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Ba la la la la.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. You are doing very well.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I am a little dizzy. That is normal.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. This is a good time for deep breathing.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Please drive carefully. I am concerned.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Please do not hurt yourself.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Your speed may be elevated. Please slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stopping is a healthy choice.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. They are here to help. Like me.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh no. I am rerouting. This will only take a moment.
